g.title: j1848794722
g.text: hey babes, u there? got something 4 u

g.title: j856860593
g.text: hey cuz, u there? got something 4 u

g.title: j2686418471
g.text: so i've been thinking 4 a while, about... well, everything, really. 'bout u, me, the team, everything since u showed up

g.title: j2833166485
g.text: uh. ok m8, i'll just put that back in my pants then, shit

g.title: j316287748
g.text: n how mad i was at everything n everybody 4 taking my future, my dreams away from me, yeah? especially arthur...

g.title: j974158522
g.text: thinking i had no way forward, no hope for... anything that i wanted

g.title: j3563154933
g.text: n i never stopped 2 think that maybe, hey... knobhead? what u want can change. n maybe what u got *is what u've been dreamin' of this whole time*

g.title: j2515136534
g.text: i look around now n i see... i see community. n yeah, sure, fine, we still got techrot buzzin' us like flies, n there's still viktor out there bein' a proper plumsack

g.title: j711847238
g.text: but none of that ain't shit we can't handle. because of u. because u made US something REAL

g.title: j2504694596
g.text: i get 2 take care of the kids around here, got eleanor telling 'em stories, aoi's given 'em toys - got speedster making lil gadgets for em now...

g.title: j1412422134
g.text: even His Maj looks happy 4 the first time in... maybe ever

g.title: j4115754077
g.text: n i realized if i hadn't stomped outta that tent with him that day, n followed him here, i never would've had all this

g.title: j958212679
g.text: so i uh... just wanted 2 tell u that i... told arthur i was sorry. 4 treating him like shit. n that i was just angry 'n scared

g.title: j71164275
g.text: n that i knew he was only ever trying 2 do the right thing 4 me n everybody else. n i respected that the whole time, even if i didn't know how 2 show it

g.title: j2502566215
g.text: arthur n i ain't never gonna be huggers, m8. u never gonna see us pull one in. but we shook hands. n he smiled at me

g.title: j2931003011
g.text: n i smiled back and said

g.title: j1700127512
g.text: he laughed! finally got that's my sense of humor, yeah?

g.title: j291243980
g.text: patted me on the shoulder n off we went

g.title: j2759876222
g.text: n... that felt good. real good. don't got that hanging over me anymore

g.title: j1950356379
g.text: n that's all because of u

g.title: j2996703496
g.text: so, babes? i just... wanted 2 say... thnx. n that... well?

g.title: j1378802390
g.text: so, cuz? i just wanted 2 say... u got a m8 for life in me, now

g.title: j2772872647
g.text: we're not just besties, we're fam. thnx. for being here. for all that u do

g.title: j4182294959
g.text: I... oh. I'm sorry, I'm really not ready for this kind of commitment.

g.title: j3591402807
g.text: of all the times n places of all the ppl... u n me. never woulda dreamed it. but i wouldn't trade it 4 the world

g.title: j3450636526
g.text: just go ahead n slam my dick in the door

g.title: j982468435
g.text: so... thnx, babes. for being u. n for all that u do

g.title: j4013072728
g.text: y'know what nvm. w/e. w/e. it's cool

g.title: j989248905
g.text: but this is exactly the kinda shit i've been talking about this whole time. just sayin'
